# Verity Mod for Minecraft Guide

> VerityModChecker.online is an independent Verity Mod source checker, download guide, and troubleshooting hub for Minecraft Java, Bedrock, MCPE, VERITY.exe, Groq, Ollama, and voice setup searches.

## Core Pages

- [Verity Mod Download for Minecraft](https://veritymodchecker.online/): Current Java and Bedrock release map plus a browser-only URL, release record, filename, displayed-size, package, and SHA-256 checker.
- [Verity Link Checker](https://veritymodchecker.online/link/): Source-check guide for official URLs, mirrors, short-link chains, filenames, Project IDs, file records, Java JARs, Bedrock MCADDONs, and modpack claims.
- [Minecraft Verity Mod Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/minecraft-verity-mod/): Broad-intent guide for Minecraft Verity Mod, Verity Minecraft, Minecraft Verity, the Verity Mod, and Verity mods searches, routing users to Java, Bedrock, MCPE, MCPEDL, server, API-error, and source-check pages by edition and file record.
- [Verity Mod Download Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/download/): Exact current CurseForge records for Verity JE, Verity BE, PnTMC, and Verity Pocket Edition (Be), plus the verified official Verity JE Modrinth route and route separation for VERITY.exe and VerityPack.
- [Verity Mod Latest Version Tracker](https://veritymodchecker.online/updates/): Human-readable current-version table for Java beta, stable Java, Bedrock, PnTMC, MCPEDL changelog, Project IDs, record IDs, and freshness signals.
- [How to Play Verity Mod](https://veritymodchecker.online/play/): Interactive play route selector for Java, Bedrock, MCPE, PS4/Xbox-friendly Bedrock hosts, TLauncher caveats, solo worlds, friends, servers, talking to Verity, spawning Verity, and broken first sessions.
- [Verity Mod Server Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/server/): Interactive server setup selector for Java Forge servers, Aternos and free hosts, Bedrock worlds or Realms, MCPE, console joiners, public server-list safety, AI provider issues, lag, and friends sessions.
- [CurseForge Verity Mod Routes](https://veritymodchecker.online/curseforge/): Explains which CurseForge category, Project ID, owner, file record, and package type matches Java, Bedrock, or MCPE searches.
- [Verity Mod Creator Reference](https://veritymodchecker.online/creators/): Copy-safe source notes, citation wording, and current route facts for YouTube descriptions, articles, community posts, and pinned comments.
- [Verity Mod FAQ](https://veritymodchecker.online/faq/): Consolidated answers for current download, Java, Bedrock, MCPE, NeoForge, voice, API 429, VERITY.exe, taken-down, and file-safety questions.
- [What Is the Verity Mod?](https://veritymodchecker.online/what-is-verity-mod/): Separates the ThatMob horror character and video experience from current playable Java and Bedrock community projects.
- [Real Verity Mod Evidence](https://veritymodchecker.online/is-verity-real/): Reality-check page for real, original, and official Verity Mod claims across ThatMob videos, Verity JE Java files, Bedrock and MCPE add-ons, APK/app results, VERITY.exe-style modpacks, current public downloads, and unsafe reposts.
- [Verity Horror Mod Guide](https://veritymodchecker.online/horror-mod/): Explains the Minecraft horror story intent, playable Java and Bedrock adaptations, feature expectations, and safer download checks.
- [How to Get and Install Verity Mod](https://veritymodchecker.online/how-to-get-verity-mod/): Edition-specific Java, Bedrock, and MCPE installation order, source checks, first-launch troubleshooting, and the canonical target for `/how-to-install/`.
- [What Happened to Verity Mod?](https://veritymodchecker.online/what-happened/): Explains old 404 links, current projects, project-name confusion, and banned/taken-down rumors for searches such as "was Verity Mod banned" and "what Minecraft horror mod was banned."
- [Verity JE Download Status](https://veritymodchecker.online/java/#versions): Java route for the Modrinth 6.0.0 beta, stable 5.7.3 Forge 1.20.1, older NeoForge 1.21.1, Groq, Ollama, and voice setup.
- [Verity Mod Java Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/java/): Java install and troubleshooting guide.
- [verity-6.0.0.jar Beta File Check](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-6-0-0-jar/): Focused file identity page for exact `verity-6.0.0.jar` and `verity 6.0.0 beta` searches, Modrinth version 5ech0sTo, Forge 1.20.1, 246,535,597 bytes, 4,483 version downloads at check, and checksum verification.
- [verity-5.7.3.jar Download Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-5-7-3-jar/): Focused download-route and file-check page for exact `verity-5.7.3.jar` and `verity 5.7.3` searches, stable Verity JE Forge 1.20.1, CurseForge record 8461257, required GeckoLib and YetAnotherConfigLib dependency check, displayed 578.1K CurseForge file downloads, Modrinth yAt0wv1Z, 237,877 Modrinth version downloads, and checksum verification.
- [verity-3.4.1.jar Status Check](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-3-4-1-jar/): Explains that the older Verity JE NeoForge 1.21.1 file maps to CurseForge record 8346795 and should not be treated as the current default Java route.
- [Verity Mod Bedrock Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/bedrock/): Bedrock addon and MCPE setup guide.
- [Verity Mod MCPE Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/pocket-edition/): Pocket Edition route comparison for Verity BE, PnTMC, and Verity Pocket Edition (Be), plus mobile import, pack activation, backend notes, and clean-world checks.
- [Verity Mod APK and App Safety](https://veritymodchecker.online/apk/): Mobile-focused route check for Google Play apps, APK claims, MCPE package types, publisher identity, app permissions, and source-trail checks before installing; includes current Play Store examples `com.verity.stalker.mobs.birchappsmcpe`, `com.goku.verity.horror`, `com.l13devstudio.verit`, `verity.mod.minecraft.pemodverity`, and `com.richmcpe.verity`.
- [Verity Mod MCPEDL Route](https://veritymodchecker.online/mcpedl/): MCPEDL and PnTMC Bedrock route check for the current 3.2.0 V26.30 file record 8517480, V26.20 record 8517478, V26.10-style record 8517473, previous 3.1.0 record 8503821, and older 2.1.0 record 8327253.
- [ThatMob's Verity 3.2.0 by PnTMC File Check](https://veritymodchecker.online/pntmc-verity-3-2-0/): Exact PnTMC 3.2.0 file identity page for the checked V26.30 record 8517480 plus current V26.20 record 8517478 and V26.10-style record 8517473, MCPEDL listing lag, previous records, and install route separation.
- [How to Spawn Verity](https://veritymodchecker.online/how-to-spawn-verity/): Route-first checklist for Verity not spawning, separating PnTMC 3.2.0, Verity BE 1.1.0, MCPE pack activation, Beta APIs, commands, clean worlds, and Java loader confusion.
- [Verity Mod Lag Fix](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-mod-lag-fix/): Performance checklist for delayed mobs, block delay, MCPE stutter, PnTMC resource-intensive AI, pack conflicts, clean-world Bedrock testing, and Java AI latency.
- [What Is VERITY.exe?](https://veritymodchecker.online/verity-exe/): Separates the VERITY.exe modpack from standalone Java and Bedrock routes.
- [Best AI Model for Verity Mod](https://veritymodchecker.online/ai-model/): Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, voice, latency, and credential-safety guidance.
- [Verity Mod API Connection Failed](https://veritymodchecker.online/api-connection-failed/): Status-code diagnosis, API-key source guidance, and a no-key quick selector for Groq 401 and 429, OpenRouter errors, Ollama connections, null replies, and voice-vs-text separation.
- [Verity Mod Status 429 Fix](https://veritymodchecker.online/status-429/): Focused rate-limit guide for Groq and OpenRouter sessions that work briefly, then return status 429; explains reset windows, organization-level limits, short text retests, and why not to replace the jar first.
- [How to Talk to Verity](https://veritymodchecker.online/how-to-talk-to-verity/): Project-specific Java controls, Verity BE chat prefix, and PnTMC wake phrase and distance rules.
- [Verity Mod Not Working](https://veritymodchecker.online/not-working/): Fixes for crashes, box not spawning, dialogue missing, and broken setup.
- [Verity Mod Voice Not Working](https://veritymodchecker.online/voice-not-working/): Voice and audio troubleshooting.
- [Verity Mod Taken Down or 404](https://veritymodchecker.online/taken-down/): Recovery checklist for old links, mirrors, and removed pages.
- [Verified Release Data](https://veritymodchecker.online/data/verity-releases.json): Machine-readable owners, project IDs, current file records, versions, sizes, dates, and source URLs.
- [Verified App Claims Data](https://veritymodchecker.online/data/verity-app-claims.json): Machine-readable Google Play package IDs, publisher names, store signals, and third-party app-claim notes for current Verity Mod mobile search results.
- [Verified Route Update Feed](https://veritymodchecker.online/feed.xml): Atom feed for point-in-time Java and Bedrock route checks.

## Current Position

Checked July 28, 2026: Verity JE now has a Modrinth `6.0.0-beta` file named `verity-6.0.0.jar` for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. It appears as Modrinth version `5ech0sTo` under project `on1Y0osD`, with SHA-1 and SHA-512 fingerprints and 4,483 version downloads at check. The stable Forge route remains `verity-5.7.3.jar`: CurseForge record `8461257` and Modrinth version `yAt0wv1Z`, with 578.1K displayed CurseForge file downloads and 237,877 Modrinth version downloads. The older Java branch `verity-3.4.1.jar` maps to CurseForge record `8346795`, 156.0 MB, about 264.3K file downloads at check, Maven coordinate `curse.maven:verity-je-1591438:8346795`, and Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge; it has its own status page because exact filename searches appeared and it should not be treated as the default Java route. Verity BE's current file-record name is `Verity (Stable) (1.1.0)-(26.3).mcaddon`, record `8506198`, for Bedrock 26.30. The PnTMC alternate has current 3.2.0 rows for V26.30 record `8517480`, V26.20 record `8517478`, and V26.10-style record `8517473`. Verity Pocket Edition (Be) is a separate similar Bedrock listing, Project ID `1596246`, with file record `8406293`. Point-in-time CurseForge project totals are 2,254,835, 3,925,180, 7,112,849, and 52,547 downloads respectively; the Modrinth Verity JE project total is 292,748. VERITY.exe and VerityPack are separate modpack routes. The site does not host files, upload selected files, collect API keys, or claim that metadata or checksum matching is a malware scan.
